Sam: Heads-up — planning a phased rollout of llmroute-v4 to search-prod at 06:30 UTC. Will use feature flag `llmroute_v4` with gradual weights and an observability holdpoint. @deploy-bot can you schedule the window and ensure the canary cohort is created? :eyes:

Priya: Agree on phased weights. Proposal: 1% -> 5% (hold) -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Holdpoint checks at 5% with latency and error gating.

Jeff: Add a version-pin option so we can pin back to v3 quickly if we see model drift. Also include a note in the release notes about rerank changes.

Maria: Deploy playbook snippet for toggling the flag:```
# create canary cohort and set initial weight
rb ff create-cohort llmroute_v4 canary --selector=region:prod-eu
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort canary --weight 1
# ramp commands
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort canary --weight 5
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort global --weight 25
```

Sam: Telemetry gates at 5%: p50 latency increase > 50ms OR error rate > 0.5% -> pause and pin back. Also watch top-10 prompts for quality regressions.

Priya: Can we have the deploy-bot automatically create a preflight snapshot of token costs and tail latency? If so, include it in the roll notes.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for llmroute_v4 at 2025-07-12T06:30:00Z. Canary cohort created (canary id: c-94a2). Will post telemetry reports at each holdpoint.

Jeff: Release notes link: https://redwood.example.com/releases/llmroute-v4 — added model change summary and rollback commands.

Maria: Quick rollback commands if needed:```
# pin global routing to v3
rb ff set llmroute_v4 --cohort global --weight 0
rb route set default --model llmroute-v3
# drain canary
rb drain cohort c-94a2 --timeout 120
```

Sam: Decision rule: if at 5% we see either latency +50ms OR error rate >0.5% OR NPS-quality drop on tracked prompts -> immediate pin to v3 and escalate to oncall. Otherwise continue ramp after 15m soak.

Priya: I'll be on watch for the 05:30 UTC preflight. Jeff, Maria — can you both stand by for the 5% holdpoint?

Jeff: On standby.

Maria: On standby, prepping a quick checklist and runbook snippet to paste into the incident channel. :white_check_mark:
